DATE : 06/01/2026.
Heard learned Counsel appearing for the parties.
2. The Challenge in this petition is to the order dated 06.09.2021 passed at Exhibits 51 and 52.

An application vide Exhibit 51 was preferred by the prosecution under Section 311 of Code of Criminal Procedure ('CRPC') for calling Shri S.S. Kulkarni Assistant Chemical Analyzer to the Government Regional Forensic Science Laboratory, State of Maharashtra, Nagpur whereas application at Exhibit 52 was also filed by the prosecution under Section 311 of CRPC calling Headmaster of Zilla Parishad Primary School Mazod, Tq. and Dist. Akola and Z.P. Kanya School, Balapur for evidence along with original Dakhal Kharij register and affidavit register of the school, previous school leaving certificate and date of birth certificate of prosecutrix.

sentences.text: So also, any other documents relating to her birth date.

Both these applications were allowed by the learned Extra Joint District Judge and Additional Sessions Judge vide orders dated 06.09.2021.
2 7.cri.wp.301.2022 3.

The learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that both these applications were filed at 4.45 pm by the prosecution and on both these applications the Court has passed orders at about 5.05 pm.

My attention was invited to paragraphs 7 and 8 of the petition wherein it is specifically averred that the applications were filed at 4.45 pm and decided at 5.05 pm by the learned Court Dilip S/O Dashrath Chauhan vs The State Of Maharashtra, Thr. sentences.text: He submits that the applications were filed behind the back of the present petitioner and were allowed by the Court without granting sufficient opportunity to the petitioner to raise an objection.

4. He further pointed out from paragraph 8 of the petition that the next date was already conveyed to the petitioner and the Roznama for 06.09.2021 does not reflect anything about filing of such applications.

On the contrary, Roznama shows that the Court was busy in other work and there is no reference of these applications, which were filed by the prosecution at Exhibits 51 and 52 and the orders passed thereon.
Therefore, opportunity of hearing was denied by the Court below, which is a violation of principles of natural justice.

5. On the other hand, the learned APP by filing affidavit in reply, points out that the averment made in the petition are incorrect as the Roznama demonstrates filing of Exhibits 51 and 52 and therefore,
he submits that there is no substance in the contentions of the petitioner.

He further submits that so far as the evidence of Headmaster i.e. PW2 is concerned, he was examined 3 7.cri.wp.301.2022 long back i.e. on 01.06.2021, not only that the petitioner availed the opportunity to cross-examine PW2 and therefore, he submits that the petition is devoid of merit.
6.
This Court vide order dated 14.09.2022, granted stay to the further proceedings before the Trial Court.
The matter is in respect of the provisions of POCSO Act and Section 376 of IPC and the same is pending since 2016 in the Trial Court.

7. After considering the rival submissions it appears to me that admittedly, Exhibits 51 and 52 were moved by the prosecution at about 4:45 pm, which could be gathered from the endorsement by the Court below.

Further it appears that orders were passed on applications for giving Say by the other side on the same day i.e. 06.09.2021, and immediately at about 5.05 pm, that means within 20 minutes impugned orders came to be passed allowing both the applications on the same day i.e. on 06.09.2021 as could be gathered from the record.
The Court below ought to have granted sufficient opportunity to the petitioner to file Say to Exhibits 51 and 52.

However, by not doing so, in my opinion, principle of natural justice has been violated and therefore, in the interest of justice, I deem it appropriate to quash the impugned order 06.09.2021 passed at Exhibits 51 and Exhibit 52.

The matter is remanded back to the Trial Court for fresh consideration on Exhibits 51 and 52.
8.
The Trial Court shall grant an opportunity to the petitioner to file an objection within one week from today.
The applications at Exhibits 51 and 52 shall be 4 7.cri.wp.301.2022 decided after filing of objection within two weeks, thereafter.
9. The Writ Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
10. Fees of the appointed Counsel be quantified as per Rules.
(M.M. NERLIKAR, J.) Trupti Signed by: Trupti D. Agrawal Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 06/01/2026 18:18:47
